slotExplanations.custom_label_0: Top-level campaign grouping, e.g. bestsellers vs. long tail.
slotExplanations.custom_label_1: Mid-funnel segmentation, e.g. margin or funnel stage.
slotExplanations.custom_label_2: Seasonal or event labels, e.g. sale, winter.
slotExplanations.custom_label_4: Free reserve, e.g. price tier or supplier.

unsavedChanges: You have unsaved changes. Leave anyway?
manageAtClient: Manage slot rules at client level

bulk.controlledByRule: Controlled by rule — no value list needed.

fields.name: Name
fields.isActiveHint: Inactive rules are skipped during runs and hidden from bulk value lists.
fields.matchFieldHint: Product field matched against the value list. Pick from the registry or type a custom path.
fields.valueTemplateHint: Use {field} tokens, e.g. {brand} - Mid Funnel. An empty token skips the rule.
fields.fallbackHint: Used when a rule matched but the template resolved empty (e.g. token skip). Only the first rule of a slot may declare it.

description: Labelizer fills Google Shopping's custom_label_0–4 slots from an ordered list of slot rules: a rule matches products (by value list or all products), renders a value template, and the first match per slot wins.

concepts.question: What are slot rules?
concepts.answer: Each rule targets one custom_label slot. Rules are evaluated top to bottom; the first matching rule with a non-empty template result fills the slot.

matchModes.question: Match value list vs. match all products?
matchModes.answer: Value-list rules label products whose match field equals one of the listed values. Match-all rules label every product — no value list needed.

templates.question: How do value templates work?
templates.answer: Use {field} tokens like {brand} - Mid Funnel. If a token resolves empty the rule is skipped; a fallback template covers that case.

scopes.question: Where do rules and bulk values live?
scopes.answer: Slot rules live at Global or Client level and merge client-over-global. Bulk values live at Client or Feed level; a feed pins inherited values on its first save.

help.title: Labelizer user guide
help.gettingStartedBody: 1. Add a rule under Slot rules and pick a target slot. 2. Choose a match mode — paste bulk IDs or let all products match. 3. Write a value template. 4. Save, then run the pipeline to see the labels in the export.
